name: Shadow theatre
one_line: Black cut-out puppets on a glowing amber screen.
look_words: A shadow-puppet play. The whole screen is a sheet of warm amber light, brighter near the lamp and darker at the edges, and everything in the world is a black silhouette in front of it. Puppets and scenery are flat cut-outs with fine pierced patterns, like lace, that let the light through; things further from the screen are softer and paler, which gives depth. The player is the sharpest, blackest shape. Because there is almost no colour, meaning comes from small coloured gels: pale gold and jade for the things that matter, crimson for harm. Motion is jointed and stiff, on rods, with a flickering flame behind. Avoid shading inside the silhouettes, more colours, camera rotation, and bloom.

palette.name: shadow play
palette.notes: The ground colours are the lit screen; structures are the black silhouettes. The player is black too, so it must stay in front of the amber, not in front of scenery.

look_wish: flat black silhouettes on a lit screen, side view

upgrade.why: a real flickering lamp flame behind the screen

music.mood: metal chimes, a bowed string and hand drums

sound_feel: wooden rods tapping, a flame flutter, cloth, small gongs
